mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SHIPMENT ( order_id, courier_name, courier_code, tracking_number, shipment_status, shipped_at, delivered_at ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{courierName}, #{courierCode}, #{trackingNumber}, #{shipmentStatus}, NOW(), CASE WHEN #{shipmentStatus} = 'DELIVERED' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END )
mapper.update: UPDATE SHIPMENT SET shipment_status = #{shipmentStatus}, delivered_at = CASE WHEN #{shipmentStatus} = 'DELIVERED' THEN NOW() ELSE delivered_at END WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SHIPMENT_HISTORY ( shipment_id, occurred_at, location, status_text, stage, time_precision ) VALUES ( #{shipmentId}, #{occurredAt}, #{location}, #{statusText}, #{stage}, #{timePrecision} )
mapper.select: SELECT history_id AS historyId, shipment_id AS shipmentId, occurred_at AS occurredAt, location, status_text AS statusText, stage, time_precision AS timePrecision FROM SHIPMENT_HISTORY WHERE shipment_id = #{shipmentId} ORDER BY occurred_at ASC
